newsitem.title: USA: Kennametal Inc names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Kennametal Inc names new chairman.

text.p: Kennametal Inc said Monday that William Newlin has been named chairman of the board.
Newlin, who has been president and chief executive of Buchanan Ingersoll Professional Corp since 1980, succeeds Quentin McKenna. Newlin has been on Kennametal's board since 1982.
The appointment is effective immediately. McKenna will remain a member of the board of directors.
Kennametal markets, manufactures and distributes tools and supplies for metalworking, mining and highway construction industries.
